integrity: All authorship/provenance claims avoided; independent audit not performed. Earlier homogeneous Dutch windmills and general outerplanar sphere-wedge alternative explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Classification restricted to ordinary matching complexes of at least two simple cycles meeting exactly at one vertex; no equivariant or graph-modification persistence claims. Finite computations corroborate rather than prove universal integral homotopy equivalence.
title: Mixed-length cycle bouquets: a sharp four-regime matching-complex homotopy classification
